title: Hundreds of thousands still without power after storms hit US on Thanksgiving
english: Severe storms across the United States during the Thanksgiving holiday have left hundreds of thousands of people without electricity. The extreme weather caused widespread travel chaos, leading to numerous flight cancellations and delays, while also forcing the postponement of major events like the Macy's Thanksgiving Day parade. Although conditions are expected to improve, authorities are working to restore power and address water supply issues in the most affected states.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የምስጋና በዓል ወቅት የተከሰተው ከባድ አውሎ ንፋስ በመላው ሀገሪቱ በብዙ መቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ለኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ ዳርጓል። ይህ አስቸጋሪ የአየር ሁኔታ ከፍተኛ የበረራ መስተጓጎልን ያስከተለ ሲሆን፣ ታዋቂው የማሲስ የምስጋና በዓል ሰልፍን ጨምሮ በርካታ ዝግጅቶች እንዲራዘሙ አድርጓል። የአየር ሁኔታው እየተሻሻለ ቢመጣም፣ ባለስልጣናት በጎዳናቸው ግዛቶች የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎትን ወደ ነበረበት ለመመለስ እና የውሃ አቅርቦት ችግሮችን ለመፍታት እየሰሩ ነው።
oromo: Ayyaana galateeffannaa yeroo Ameerikaatti kabajamaa turetti bubbeen cimaan mudachuu isaan, namoota dhibba hedduu kuman lakkaawaman ibsaan ala godheera. Haalli qilleensa hamaa kun imaltootaaf rakkoo uumee balalliiwwan hedduu kan haqe yoo ta'u, ayyaana beekamaa Macy's Parade dabalatee sagantaaleen hedduun akka deddeebi'an dirqisiiseera. Haalli qilleensaa fooyya'aa kan jiru ta'us, qondaalonni naannolee miidhaman keessatti ibsaa fi bishaan dhiyeessuu deebisuuf tattaaffii gochaa jiru.

title: Leaders clash in final Spain election debate as housing dominates run-in
english: Spain's political leaders held a heated final debate ahead of Sunday’s election, with the country’s severe housing crisis serving as the central theme. Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez faces potential defeat as polls favor a conservative-led government that could include the far-right Vox party for the first time in decades. Citizens across the nation have been protesting the lack of affordable homes, creating a challenging environment for politicians to address widespread financial instability.

oromo: Hoggantoonni siyaasaa Ispeen filannoo Dilbata dhufuuf qophaa'aa jiran irratti, rakkoon manaa biyyattii keessa jiru mata duree guddaa ta'ee ture. Muummichi ministeeraa Pedro Sanchez mo'atamuu malu jedhamee kan eegamu yoo ta'u, morkattoonni isaanii garuu mootummaa haaraa dhaabbata mirga-gooftoota (conservative) fi garee mirga-dursaa 'Vox' waliin ijaaruuf carraa qabu. Biyyattii keessatti lammiileen gatiin mana gatii kaffaltii isaanii ol ta'uu mormaa jiru, kunis dhiibbaa siyaasaa cimaa uumee jira.

title: Italy's former police chief rejected mafia inquiry allegations before death
english: Gianni De Gennaro, Italy's former police chief, died by suspected suicide shortly after writing a letter denying accusations that he hampered investigations into the 1990s Mafia killings of two prominent judges. In his final note, he insisted on his innocence and maintained that he never violated his professional duties or integrity. The incident has caused significant public outcry and has prompted high-level government officials to call for a thorough investigation to uncover the truth.
amharic: የጣሊያን የቀድሞ የፖሊስ አዛዥ የነበሩት ጂያኒ ዲ ጄናሮ በ1990ዎቹ ከተፈጸሙት የማፊያ ግድያዎች ጋር በተያያዘ ምርመራን አደናቅፈዋል በሚል የቀረበባቸውን ክስ በመቃወም ከሞታቸው በፊት ደብዳቤ ትተው አልፈዋል። በአስቸኳይ ጊዜ በጻፉት በዚህ ማስታወሻ ላይ፣ ህይወታቸው ከማለፉ በፊት እንደማይዋሹ በመግለጽ በሀገራቸው ላይ ክህደት እንዳልፈጸሙ አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በጣሊያን ከፍተኛ መነጋገሪያ የፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ የሀገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት ጉዳዩን በገለልተኝነት እንዲጣራ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan poolisii duraanii Xaaliyaanii Gianni De Gennaro, ajjeechaa maafiyaa bara 1990 keessa raawwatamee ture irratti qorannoo gufachiiseera jedhamee himatamee ture deebii kennachuu isaa duratti of ajjeesuun isaa shakkameera. Xalayaa du'a dura barreesse irratti, himannaa irratti dhiyaate kana haaluun, hojii isaa keessatti amanamummaa isaa akka hin diigne ibseera. Taateen kun Xaaliyaan keessatti oduu gurguddaa ta'ee jiraachuu isaa hordofee, hoggantoonni biyyattii qorannoon dhugaan isaa akka ba'u gaafachaa jiru.

title: Ex-media executive admits saying Australian child sex abuse survivor 'looking to be raped again'
english: Matt Handbury, a former Australian media executive, has apologized after making a repulsive comment about child abuse survivor Grace Tame at a public event. Tame, who was named Australian of the Year for her advocacy, confronted Handbury after he claimed her outfit suggested she wanted to be sexually assaulted. Handbury later admitted to the remark and expressed regret, though Tame noted that she was disappointed by the failure of others in the room to stand up for her during the incident.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአውስትራሊያ የሚዲያ ስራ አስፈፃሚ ማት ሀንበሪ በህዝባዊ ዝግጅት ላይ ለህፃናት ጥቃት ሰለባዋ ግሬስ ታሜ ከተናገሩት አጸያፊ አስተያየት በኋላ ይቅርታ ጠይቀዋል። የህፃናት መብት ተሟጋች እና የቀድሞ የአመቱ ምርጥ አውስትራሊያዊት የሆነችው ታሜ፣ ሀንበሪ የለበሰችውን ልብስ ምክንያት በማድረግ ለጥቃት እንደምትፈልግ ሲናገር በቦታው ፊት ለፊት ተጋፍጠዋለች። ሀንበሪ ጥፋቱን በማመን ይቅርታ ቢጠይቅም፣ በወቅቱ በዝግጅቱ ላይ የነበሩ ሌሎች ሰዎች ድርጊቱን ችላ ማለታቸው አሳዛኝ እንደሆነ ታሜ ገልጻለች።
oromo: Goggeessaan miidiyaa Awustiraaliyaa duraanii Matt Handbury, dubartii miidhaa saalaa cimaa irra darbee ture Grace Tame irratti dubbii arrabsituu dubbateef dhiifama gaafateera. Tame, itti gaafatamtuu mirga daa'immanii fi badhaasa 'Australian of the Year' argatte, Handbury uffata isheetiin wal qabsiisee qoosuu isaa erga dhageesse booda gara fuulduraatti baatee isa gaafatteetti. Handbury dubbii isaa kana amanee dhiifama gaafateera; ta'us, Tame yeroo sana namoonni achi turan balaaleffachuu dhiisuun isaanii akka ishee aarse ibsiteetti.

title: Israeli attacks on women and girls meant ‘to destroy life’ in Gaza: Amnesty
english: Amnesty International has accused Israel of carrying out a systematic campaign against women and girls in Gaza, claiming the actions are intended to destroy the Palestinian population. The report highlights that daily killings, forced displacement, and the deliberate destruction of medical and reproductive healthcare facilities are being used to prevent births. These strategies, which include blocking access to essential services and attacking maternity infrastructure, are being characterized by the organization as acts of genocide.
amharic: አምነስቲ ኢንተርናሽናል እስራኤል በጋዛ በሚገኙ ሴቶች እና ልጃገረዶች ላይ ስልታዊ ጥቃት በመፈጸም የፍልስጤም ህዝብን ለማጥፋት እየሰራች ነው ሲል ከሰሰ። ድርጅቱ ባወጣው ሪፖርት መሰረት በየቀኑ የሚፈጸመው ግድያ፣ ከቤት ንብረት ማፈናቀል እና የጤና አገልግሎቶችን በተለይም የወሊድ ህክምና ተቋማትን ማውደም የህዝብ ቁጥር እድገትን ለመግታት ያለመ ነው። እነዚህን መሰል ተግባራት እና የህክምና አገልግሎቶች መከልከል ድርጅቱ እንደ ዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል ፈርጆታል።
oromo: Amnestii Internaashinaal, Israa'el gaazaa keessatti dubartootaa fi shamarran irratti tarkaanfii suukanneessaa fudhachaa jirtuun uummata Falasxiin balleessuuf karoorfatteetti jechuun himate. Gabaasichi akka ibsutti, ajjeechaan guyyaa guyyaan raawwatamu, namoota qe'ee isaanii irraa ari'uu fi buufataalee fayyaa keessattuu kan haadhaa fi daa'immanii mancaasuun baay'ina uummataa hir'isuuf kan karoorfame dha. title: Tyson Fury’s wife backtracks on claim boxer suffers from schizophrenia
english: Paris Fury has officially corrected her previous statement claiming that her husband, boxer Tyson Fury, had been diagnosed with schizophrenia. She explained that she had used the term incorrectly when describing his past mental health challenges and confirmed he has never received such a diagnosis. Netflix has adjusted the upcoming documentary footage to reflect this clarification as the boxer prepares for his upcoming match against Anthony Joshua.
amharic: የታይሰን ፊዩሪ ባለቤት ፓሪስ ፊዩሪ፣ ባሏ በሽዞፈሪኒያ በሽታ እንደተያዘ ቀደም ብላ የሰጠችውን አስተያየት አስተካክላለች። ፓሪስ ቀደም ሲል ለባለቤቷ የጤና ሁኔታ የሰጠችው መግለጫ ትክክል እንዳልሆነ እና ታይሰን በዚያ በሽታ እንዳልተመረመረ ገልጻለች። ይህ ማብራሪያ ታይሰን ፊዩሪ ከአንቶኒ ጆሹዋ ጋር ለሚያደርገው የቦክስ ግጥሚያ እየተዘጋጀ ባለበት ወቅት የወጣ ሲሆን፣ ኔትፍሊክስም በዶክመንተሪው ላይ ተገቢውን ማስተካከያ አድርጓል።

title: Pakistan’s viral cricket catch star hopes to launch career
english: Mehran Khan, a government employee from Pakistan's Swat Valley, recently gained global fame after a video of him making an impressive cricket catch while riding on a motorcycle went viral. Following his sudden internet popularity, he has expressed a strong desire to pursue a professional cricket career. He now hopes that this newfound attention will help him eventually represent Pakistan on the national cricket team.

title: US shoppers get ready for Black Friday and Cyber Monday
english: Retailers across the United States are preparing for their busiest shopping period of the year during Black Friday and Cyber Monday. While these days typically kick off the holiday season with major discounts, consumers are exercising caution due to current economic pressures and the rising cost of living. Experts note that although retailers have been offering sales for weeks, some of the best deals on electronics might actually appear shortly after the main holiday weekend events conclude.

english: President Donald Trump has announced his support for Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi’s agenda to strengthen government authority. The U.S. government aims to back these efforts to ensure state control over all weapons and resources within the country.

title: Gaza’s children caught in the grip of a meningitis outbreak
english: Gaza is currently facing a serious meningitis outbreak as the region's healthcare system remains devastated by the ongoing conflict. With over 1,700 cases reported this year and limited access to essential medicines, hospitals are struggling to treat sick children amid severe overcrowding and poor sanitary conditions. Families are calling for urgent humanitarian aid to ensure their children have access to clean water, medicine, and adequate medical care.

english: President Volodymyr Zelensky has expressed frustration with the United States, claiming the country is too distracted by Middle Eastern affairs and is failing to exert sufficient pressure on Russia. Additionally, Zelensky questioned Donald Trump’s friendly relationship with Vladimir Putin, arguing that the Russian leader is an aggressor who cannot be treated as an ally.

oromo: Pirezidaantiin Yukireen Volodimiir Zeeleniskii, Ameerikaan dhimma Baha Gidduu galeessaarratti xiyyeeffachuu irra darbtee, biyyattiin dhiibbaa ga'aa Raashiyaar irratti gochuu dhabuushee ceephataniiru. Meeshaaleen ittisaa barbaachisoon haala yerootiin dhihaachuu dhabuun lubbuu lammiilee Yukireen hedduu galaafachaa akka jiru himaniiru. Kana malees, Zeeleniskiin hariiroo michummaa Doonaald Traampii fi Vilaadimiir Puutin gidduu jiru kan ajaa'ibu ta'uu ibsuun, Puutin weerartuu fi nama ajjeesu waan ta'eef michuu ta'uu akka hin dandeenye dubbataniiru.

title: Major Thanksgiving storm brings flooding, flight delays across US
english: A massive storm is causing significant travel disruptions across the United States during the busy Thanksgiving holiday period, leading to hundreds of flight cancellations and thousands of delays. Powerful winds and heavy rainfall have triggered widespread flooding and caused power outages for nearly one million households. Several states have declared emergencies as authorities work to restore electricity and manage the damage caused by the severe weather.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የምስጋና በዓል ሰሞን የተከሰተ ከባድ አውሎ ንፋስ በጉዞ ላይ ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎልን ፈጥሯል፤ ይህም በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ በረራዎች እንዲሰረዙ እና በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ እንዲዘገዩ ምክንያት ሆኗል። ከፍተኛ ዝናብ እና ንፋስ በስፋት ጎርፍ እንዲከሰት እና ወደ አንድ ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ቤቶች ያለ ኤሌክትሪክ እንዲቀሩ አድርጓል። በርካታ ግዛቶች አስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ ያወጁ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦትን ለመመለስ እና የደረሰውን ጉዳት ለመጠገን ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Bu'aa ba'ii guyyaa ayyaana galateeffannaa (Thanksgiving) irratti, obomboleettiin cimaan tokko guutuu biyya Ameerikaa keessatti geejjiba irratti gufuu cimaa uumeera; kunis balalliiwwan hedduu akka haqaman fi hedduun immoo akka turan taasiseera. Roobni cimaa fi bubbeen humna qabu lolaa bal'aa hordofsiisee, manneen hanga miiliyoona tokkotti dhiyaatan ibsaa dhabaniiru. Mootummoonni naannolee garagaraa labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa kan labsan yoo ta'u, hojjettoonni rakkoo mudate kana furuufi humna ibsaa deebisuuf tattaaffii gochaa jiru.

title: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat
english: New Zealand’s current governing coalition has narrowly failed to secure an outright parliamentary majority, leaving them one seat short. Prime Minister Christopher Luxon must now negotiate with the Opportunity Party to form a stable government. If these coalition talks fail, the country faces the possibility of returning to the polls for a new election.
amharic: የኒውዚላንድ ገዥው ጥምረት በፓርላማ አብላጫ ድምፅ ለማግኘት በአንድ መቀመጫ ብቻ ተቀንሶበታል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ክሪስቶፈር ላክሰን የተረጋጋ መንግስት ለመመስረት ከኦፖርቹኒቲ ፓርቲ ጋር ድርድር ማድረግ ይጠበቅባቸዋል። ድርድሩ ካልተሳካ ሀገሪቱ እንደገና ወደ ምርጫ ልትሄድ ትችላለች።
oromo: Mootummaan biyya Niiw Ziilaand kutaalee koalishinii isaa waliin ta’uun, harka caaluu paarlaamaa argachuuf teessoo tokko qofa hanqateera. Muummeen Ministiraa Kiriistoofar Laakson mootummaa tasgabbaa'aa ta’e ijaaruuf paartii ‘Oportuuniti’ waliin mari'achuu qabu. Mariin kun yoo milkaa'uu baate, biyyattiin deebitee gara filannoo biraatti ce’uun ishee hin oolu.

title: Trump says the US has ‘close to 50%’ of world’s oil
english: Former President Donald Trump stated that the United States possesses nearly half of the global oil supply, arguing that the nation no longer relies on Middle Eastern energy. He explained that the American military presence in the region is primarily intended to safeguard Israel and other regional allies. Consequently, he emphasized that the U.S. is not motivated by oil interests in its foreign policy decisions.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ ከዓለም ግማሽ ያህል የነዳጅ ሀብት እንዳላት ተናግረዋል። አገሪቱ ከመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ላይ ጥገኛ እንዳልሆነች የገለጹት ትራምፕ፣ በአካባቢው ያለው የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ቆይታ ዋና ዓላማ እስራኤልን እና ሌሎች አጋር አገሮችን ለመጠበቅ እንደሆነ አስረድተዋል። ስለዚህም አሜሪካ በአካባቢው የምትገኘው በነዳጅ ፍላጎት ምክንያት እንዳልሆነ አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Pirezidantii duraanii Ameerikaa Doolaard Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, Ameerikaan harka walakkaa qabeenya boba'aa addunyaa kan qabdu yoo ta'u, biyyattis boba'aa biyyoota giddu-galeessa bahaarratti kan hirkattu miti. Raayyaan ittisaa Ameerikaa naannichatti argamu inni guddaan eegumsa Israa'elii fi biyyoota ollaa gargaaruuf akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Kanaafuu, Ameerikaan naannichatti kan argamtu fedhii boba'aatiin akka hin taane dubbataniiru.

title: Clashes halt match as Turkiye football fans raise Palestinian flags
english: A UEFA football match between the Turkish club Besiktas and Israel’s Hapoel Be’er Sheva was paused for 30 minutes due to physical altercations. The trouble began when Besiktas supporters displayed Palestinian flags and shouted slogans against Israel, leading to confrontations with Georgian police. The incident forced officials to stop the game temporarily before order could be restored.
amharic: በቱርኩ ክለብ ቤሺክታሽ እና በእስራኤሉ ሃፖኤል ቤርሼቫ መካከል ሲካሄድ በነበረው የዩኢኤፍኤ (UEFA) እግር ኳስ ጨዋታ ላይ የፖሊስ እና የደጋፊዎች ግጭት ተፈጥሮ ጨዋታው ለግማሽ ሰዓት እንዲቋረጥ ተደርጓል። ግጭቱ የተቀሰቀሰው የቤሺክታሽ ደጋፊዎች የፍልስጤም ባንዲራዎችን በማውለብለብ በእስራኤል ላይ የተቃውሞ መፈክሮችን ማሰማታቸውን ተከትሎ ነው። የጆርጂያ ፖሊስ ደጋፊዎቹን ለመቆጣጠር በሞከረበት ወቅት በተፈጠረው አለመግባባት የጨዋታው ሂደት ለጊዜው ተስተጓጉሏል።
oromo: Tapha kubbaa miilaa UEFA kan kilabii Turkii Besiktasfi Hapoel Be'er Sheva kan Israa'el gidduutti gaggeeffamaa ture, walitti bu'iinsa uumameen daqiiqaa 30f addaan citee ture. Walitti bu'iinsi kun kan uumame yeroo deggertoonni Besiktas alaabaa Falastiin ol qabatanii fi Israa'el irratti mormii dhageessisanitti. Poolisiin Joorjiyaa deggertoota kana to'achuuf yaalii gochuun isaa walitti bu'iinsicha kan hordofsiise yoo ta'u, kunis taphichi yeroodhaaf akka dhaabatu dirqisiiseera.

title: Global news agency AFP reports cyberattack, shuts down content platform
english: The international news agency AFP has temporarily shut down its client content platform, AFP Forum, following a cyberattack early Thursday. The organization is currently working to investigate the breach and is providing alternative access for its subscribers while the site remains offline. This incident occurs as French cybersecurity officials warn of a significant increase in digital threats across the region.
amharic: የአለም አቀፍ የዜና ተቋም ኤኤፍፒ (AFP) በደረሰበት የሳይበር ጥቃት ምክንያት የደንበኞች መረጃ መለዋወጫ መድረኩን ለጊዜው ዘግቷል። ተቋሙ ጥቃቱን የመረመረ ሲሆን፣ ስርዓቱ እስኪስተካከል ድረስ ለደንበኞቹ አማራጭ የመረጃ ማግኛ መንገዶችን እያመቻቸ ይገኛል። ይህ ክስተት በፈረንሳይ የሳይበር ደህንነት ባለስልጣናት በአገሪቱ እየጨመረ ስለመጣው ከፍተኛ የሳይበር ጥቃት ስጋት ማስጠንቀቂያ በሰጡበት ወቅት የተከሰተ ነው።
oromo: Miidiyaan oduu addunyaa AFP jedhamu, erga haleellaa saayibarii erga irra ga'ee booda marsariitii isaa kan abbootii qabeenyaa fi hordoftoota isaa tajaajilu yeroof dhaabuu isaa beeksiseera. Dhaabbatichi haleellaa kana qorachaa kan jiru yoo ta'u, hanga marsariitichi deebi'ee banamutti haala biroo fayyadamuun oduuwwan dhiyeessaa jira. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame, qondaaltonni nageenya saayibarii Faransaay miidhaa saayibarii biyyattii mudachaa jiru irratti akeekkachiisa cimaa kennaa jiranitti.

title: Inside Ukraine’s power crisis amid its war with Russia
english: Ukraine is currently facing a severe energy crisis as ongoing conflict with Russia disrupts essential infrastructure. Residents and local businesses in the capital are frequently experiencing power and water outages, forcing them to rely on generators for daily needs. People are actively adapting their routines to cope with these challenging circumstances as the war continues to impact their access to basic services.
amharic: ዩክሬን ከሩሲያ ጋር ባላት ቀጣይ ጦርነት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የሆነ የኢነርጂ ቀውስ ገጥሟታል። የሀገሪቱ ዋና ከተማ ነዋሪዎችና የንግድ ተቋማት የኤሌክትሪክና የውሃ አቅርቦት መቋረጥ ችግር ስላለባቸው በጄኔሬተር ለመጠቀም ተገደዋል። ጦርነቱ መሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶችን እያስተጓጎለ በመሆኑ፣ ነዋሪዎች ከዚህ አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ጋር ለመላመድ እየሞከሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Yukireeniin waraana Raashiyaa waliin jirtuun walqabatee rakkoo humna ibsaa cimaa keessa jirti. Magaalaa guddoo biyyattii keessatti guutuun ibsaa fi bishaanii yeroo baayyee waan mudatuuf, namoonni fi dhaabbileen daldalaa humna ibsaa argachuuf jecha jeeneraataratti hirkachuuf dirqamaniiru. Waraanni kun tajaajila bu'uuraa irratti dhiibbaa geessisaa waan jiruuf, jiraattonni haala cimaa kana keessa jiraachuuf wal-simachaa jiru.

title: America’s Thanksgiving holiday seen through different eyes
english: While many Americans celebrate Thanksgiving, Indigenous communities mark the day as a National Day of Mourning. This annual event in Plymouth serves as a protest against the historical legacy of colonization, land loss, and violence inflicted upon Native peoples. The gathering highlights the starkly different perspectives regarding the holiday's meaning and its impact on Indigenous history.
amharic: ብዙ አሜሪካውያን የምስጋና በዓልን ሲያከብሩ፣ የአገሬው ተወላጆች ግን ይህንን ቀን ‘የሐዘን ቀን’ ብለው ይጠሩታል። በፕሊማውዝ የሚካሄደው ይህ አመታዊ ተቃውሞ በአገሬው ተወላጆች ላይ ለዘመናት የደረሰውን የቅኝ ግዛት፣ የመሬት መነጠቅ እና የጥቃት ታሪክ ለማስታወስ ነው። ዝግጅቱ የበዓሉን ትርጉም በተመለከተ በህዝቦች መካከል ያለውን የተለየ አመለካከት ያንፀባርቃል።
oromo: Namoonni Ameerikaa hedduun guyyaa galata kabajaa jiranis, lammiileen biyyattii kanneen jalqabaa garuu guyyaan kun 'Guyyaa Gadda' akka ta'e ibsu. Guyyaan kun Pliimaawusitti kan kabajamu yoo ta'u, seenaa qolonii, lafa irraa buqqifamuu fi miidhaa lammiilee kana irra ga'aa ture mormuuf kan gargaaru dha. Walgahii kana irratti, hiikni guyyaa kanaa ilaalchisee yaanni garaa garaa akka jiru ifa ta'a.

title: Several countries slam suspected Iranian attack on Kuwait
english: Multiple nations have denounced a recent drone strike in Kuwait that resulted in the deaths of two Italian citizens. While Saudi Arabia and Syria have openly blamed Iran for the aggression, Tehran has officially denied any involvement in the incident. Several international leaders have expressed their solidarity with the victims and condemned the violence as a threat to regional stability.
amharic: በኩዌት የደረሰውን የድሮን ጥቃት ተከትሎ ሁለት ጣሊያናውያን መሞታቸውን ተከትሎ በርካታ ሀገራት ጥቃቱን አውግዘዋል። ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ሶሪያ ጥቃቱን ኢራን እንደፈፀመችው ቢከሱም፣ የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ግን ውንጀላውን አስተባብለዋል። ዓለም አቀፍ መሪዎች ለተጎጂዎች ያላቸውን ድጋፍ በመግለጽ ጥቃቱ ለቀጠናው ሰላም ስጋት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Kuweetitti haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feeneen raawwatamee lubbuun lammiilee Xaaliyaanii lamaa darbuun isaa biyyoota hedduun balaaleffatameera. Hoggantoonni addunyaa miidhamtootaaf gadda isanii ibsuun, gochi kun tasgabbii naannichaa kan boorreesse ta'uu beeksisaniiru.

title: Watch: Israeli forces demolish Palestinian livestock farming community without prior notice
english: Israeli forces recently destroyed around 50 buildings, including residential homes and animal shelters, in the Palestinian village of Samra without giving any warning. This action follows a series of attacks by Israeli settlers in the Jordan Valley region. Currently, the displaced families are forced to share a single tent while their livestock remain exposed to the elements.

oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el ganda qonnaan bulaa Filisxeemii kan Samraa jedhamu keessatti mana jireenyaa fi bakka horiin itti bulan 50 ta'an dursanii akeekkachiisa tokko malee diiganiiru. Tarkaanfiin kun qaqqabee kan jiru, naannoo sulula Yordaanositti weerartoonni Israa'el miidhaa irra deddeebiin ga'aa turanii booda dha. Ammaaf, maatiin manneen isaanii dhaban dunkaana tokko keessa jiraachuuf dirqamaniiru, akkasumas horiin isaanii bakka itti qubatan dhabanii jiru.

title: Sex, drugs, Israeli tech and Trump rivalries: Five explosive claims from Kushner-UAE book
english: A new book by journalist Matthew Cole alleges that Jared Kushner received $2 billion from Saudi and Emirati governments during his time as a Trump administration official. The author claims that a portion of these funds, funneled through a charity, was misused for military activities and arms purchases. While Kushner has strongly denied these accusations, there are calls for a formal congressional investigation into the matter.
amharic: ጋዜጠኛ ማቲው ኮል በጻፈው አዲስ መጽሐፍ፣ የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አማች የሆኑት ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በስልጣን ላይ በነበሩበት ወቅት ከሳውዲ እና ከተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች መንግስታት በድምሩ 2 ቢሊዮን ዶላር እንደተቀበሉ ይገልጻል። መጽሐፉ እንደሚለው፣ በበጎ አድራጎት ድርጅት ስም የተላለፈው ገንዘብ ለጦር መሳሪያ ግዢ እና ለወታደራዊ ስራዎች ውሏል። ኩሽነር እነዚህን ክሶች በጥብቅ ቢክዱም፣ ጉዳዩ በኮንግረስ እንዲጣራ ጥሪዎች እየቀረቡ ነው።
oromo: Gaazexeessaa Maatiw Kool kitaaba isaa haaraa keessatti, Jareed Kushner yeroo mootummaa Traampitti mootummoota Saudii fi Emireetota Arabaa irraa qarshii biiliyoona lama argachuu isaa himateera. Qorannoon kun akka ibsutti, qarshii kana keessaa harki tokko dhaabbata gargaarsaa maqaa godhatee meeshaa waraanaa bituuf fi hojii waraanaaf ooleera. Kushner himata kana kan haale yoo ta'u, dhimmi kun Mana Maree Kongiresiin qoratamu qaba jedhamee gaafatamaa jira.

title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey sign two defence cooperation agreements
english: Saudi Arabia and Turkey have officially signed two new agreements to boost their partnership in the defense sector. These deals focus on collaborating on research, development, and new military technologies. The pacts were finalized in Ankara between Saudi officials and two prominent Turkish defense and scientific institutions.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ቱርክ በመከላከያ ዘርፍ ያላቸውን ትብብር ለማጠናከር ሁለት አዳዲስ ስምምነቶችን ተፈራርመዋል። እነዚህ ስምምነቶች በጋራ ምርምር፣ ልማት እና አዳዲስ ወታደራዊ ቴክኖሎጂዎች ላይ ያተኮሩ ናቸው። ስምምነቶቹ የተፈረሙት በአንካራ ከተማ በሳውዲ ባለስልጣናት እና በሁለት የቱርክ የመከላከያና የሳይንስ ተቋማት መካከል ነው።

title: Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US
english: Severe storms are impacting multiple regions across the United States as the Thanksgiving holiday period begins. Powerful winds and flooding have caused significant damage, including destroyed roofs and widespread power outages for hundreds of thousands of residents. Additionally, the extreme weather has disrupted travel plans, leading to the cancellation of hundreds of flights.
amharic: የምስጋና በዓል ቅዳሜና እሁድ መጀመሪያ ላይ በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ በተከሰተ ከባድ የአየር ሁኔታ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል። ኃይለኛ የንፋስ አውሎ ነፋሶች የቤት ጣራዎችን በማውለቅ እና ጎርፍ በመፍጠር በበርካታ ግዛቶች ውስጥ የመብራት አገልግሎት እንዲቋረጥ አድርገዋል። ይህ አስከፊ የአየር ንብረት በብዙ መቶ የሚቆጠሩ በረራዎች እንዲሰረዙ በማድረግ የብዙ ሰዎችን የጉዞ እቅድ አዛብቷል።

Bubbeen cimaan fi lolaan manneen irratti miidhaa geessisee, akkasumas namoota dhibba kumaatamaan lakka'aman irra waraqaa ibsaa gadi buusee jira. title: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one
english: A Malta-flagged oil tanker carrying 7,000 tonnes of diesel capsized off the coast of Ibiza, resulting in the death of one crew member. While the other 16 crew members were rescued, several required medical treatment for injuries including hypothermia. Authorities have deployed pollution control teams to monitor the partially submerged vessel for any signs of an environmental fuel spill.
amharic: 7,000 ቶን ናፍጣ የጫነ መርከብ በኢቢዛ የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ በመገልበጡ አንድ የአውሮፕላን ሰራተኛ ህይወቱ አልፏል። ሌሎች 16 የመርከቧ ሰራተኞች በህይወት ቢተርፉም፣ አንዳንዶቹ በብርድ እና በደረሰባቸው ጉዳት የህክምና እርዳታ እየተደረገላቸው ነው። ባለስልጣናት መርከቧ በከፊል መስጠሟን ተከትሎ ሊከሰት የሚችለውን የአካባቢ ብክለት ለመቆጣጠር ክትትል እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Markabii boba'aa toonii 7,000 fe'ee deemu tokko qarqara galaana Ibiza biratti gombifamee lubbuun hojjataa tokkoo darbeera. Hojjetoonni 16 biroo lubbuun kan ooran yoo ta'u, isaan keessaa muraasni isaanii miidhaa qaamaa fi qorraan walqabatee hospitaala galanii jiru. Abbootiin taayitaa markabichi gartokkoon bishaan keessa waan jiruuf, boba'aan gara galaanatti gadhiifamee miidhaa naannoo akka hin geessisne qorachaa jiru.

title: Gérard Depardieu to stand trial for alleged rape of actress in 2018, court rules
english: A French appeals court has ruled that actor Gérard Depardieu must face trial for the alleged 2018 rape of actress Charlotte Arnould. Although the actor has consistently denied these claims, the judicial process will now move forward following years of legal investigation. This decision follows a series of other sexual misconduct allegations made against the 77-year-old performer in recent years.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ይግባኝ ሰሚ ፍርድ ቤት ተዋናይ ጄራርድ ዲፓርዲዩ እ.ኤ.አ በ2018 በተዋናይት ሻርሎት አርኖልድ ላይ በፈጸሙት የተባለ የጾታዊ ጥቃት ክስ እንዲመሰረትባቸው ወስኗል። ተዋናዩ የቀረበባቸውን ክስ በጽኑ ቢክዱም፣ ለዓመታት የዘለቀው የምርመራ ሂደት ወደ ፍርድ ቤት ማቅናት ችሏል። ይህ ውሳኔ በቅርብ ዓመታት ውስጥ በእድሜ ባለጸጋው ተዋናይ ላይ ከቀረቡ ተከታታይ የጾታዊ ጥቃት ክሶች አንዱ አካል ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii ol’aanaa Faransaayti, abbaa seeraa fi taphataa filmii beekamaa Jeeraard Diipaardiiyoo irratti, himannaa gudeeddii bara 2018 irratti dhihaateen akka mana murtiitti dhiyaatu murteesseera. Taphataan kun himannaa kana irra deddeebi’ee kan haale yoo ta’u, qorannoon waggoota hedduuf ture ammaa booda gara murtii mana murtiitti ce’eera. Murtuun kun himannoo yakka walqunnamtii saalaa kan waggoota darban keessa taphataa umrii 77 kana irratti dhihaachaa turan keessaa isa tokko.

title: Peru burns more than 10 tonnes of seized drugs
english: Peruvian authorities have incinerated over 10 tonnes of confiscated illegal narcotics during their final drug destruction event of 2026. This operation contributes to a total of nearly 65 tonnes of substances, including cocaine, marijuana, and ketamine, destroyed by the state throughout the year. These efforts highlight the country's ongoing commitment to combating drug trafficking.
amharic: የፔሩ ባለስልጣናት በ2026 የመጨረሻው የዕፅ ማጥፊያ ዘመቻቸው ከ10 ቶን በላይ የተያዙ አደንዛዥ እጾችን አቃጥለዋል። ይህ የቅርብ ጊዜ ተግባር በዓመቱ ውስጥ በድምሩ 65 ቶን የሚጠጉ ኮኬይን፣ ማሪዋና እና ኬታሚንን ጨምሮ የተወረሱ ዕጾችን ለማጥፋት ተችሏል። ይህም ሀገሪቱ በህገ-ወጥ የዕፅ ዝውውር ላይ የምታደርገውን ጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni biyya Peru bara 2026 keessatti raawwii qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochan balleessuu isaanii dhumaa irratti, qoricha to'annoo jala oole toonii 10 ol ta'u gubaniiru. Guyyaa har'aa gubamuun kun, guutummaa bara kanaa keessatti qorichoota akka kookayiinii, maariwaanaa fi keetaamiinii dabalatee walitti qabaa toonii 65 ta'u balleessuuf gargaareera. Tarkaanfiin kunis biyyattiin daldala qoricha seeraan alaa to'achuuf carraaqqii gochaa jirtu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Why are winter rains forcing Palestinians in Gaza to flee again?
english: Heavy winter rainfall has caused widespread flooding in Gaza, destroying tents and leaving hundreds of thousands of displaced people without adequate shelter. The situation is exacerbated by severe humanitarian aid restrictions and the destruction of infrastructure, making it nearly impossible for families to find safe, dry places to stay. Tragically, these conditions have already led to the deaths of several children due to drowning, hypothermia, and collapsing structures.
amharic: በጋዛ የጣለው ከባድ የክረምት ዝናብ ሰፊ ጎርፍ በማስከተሉ፣ የተፈናቀሉ ሰዎች መጠለያዎች እንዲወድሙ እና በመቶ ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ነዋሪዎች ከለላ እንዲያጡ አድርጓል። የሰብአዊ እርዳታ እገዳ እና የመሰረተ ልማት ውድመት ቤተሰቦች አስተማማኝ እና ደረቅ መጠለያ እንዳያገኙ እያደረጋቸው ይገኛል። ይህ አስከፊ ሁኔታ ህፃናትን ጨምሮ በጎርፍ፣ በብርድ እና በህንፃዎች ውድቀት ምክንያት የበርካታ ሰዎችን ህይወት ቀጥፏል።
oromo: Roobni cimaan yeroo bonaa Gaazaatti roobe lolaa guddaa fiduun, dunkaanni baqattootaa akka manca'uufi namoonni hedduun bakka bullaa dhabuun akka rakkatan taasiseera. Gargaarsi namoomaa daangeffamuufi bu'uraalee misoomaa barbada'uun, maatiin bakka tasgabbaa'aa fi gogogaa ta'e akka hin arganne taasiseera. Haalli kun mudannoo gaddisiisaa ijoollee dabalatee lubbuu namoota hedduu lolaan, qabbanaan fi manni jireenyaa diigamuun akka darbu taasiseera.

title: Judge strikes down Trump’s latest restrictions on US birthright citizenship
english: A U.S. federal judge has blocked the Trump administration's attempt to restrict birthright citizenship for children born to parents who are not legal residents. The judge ruled that the Constitution grants citizenship to anyone born on American soil regardless of their parents' status. This decision follows a similar legal setback from a Maryland court and maintains that the President lacks the authority to unilaterally alter constitutional birthright protections.

Abbaan seerichaa akka jedhetti, heera mootummaan Amerikaa daa'imman biyyattii keessatti dhalatan hundaaf, haalli warra isaanii maal iyyuu yoo ta'e, mirga lammummaa akka kennu mirkaneesseera. title: Psychiatric care under scrutiny after abuse scandals in Croatia and Bosnia
english: Public outrage has erupted in Croatia and Bosnia following shocking videos that revealed medical staff abusing vulnerable psychiatric patients. These incidents, including a fatal suffocation in Zagreb and physical violence in Zenica, have led to multiple arrests and the resignation of institutional leaders. The scandals have drawn intense criticism regarding the lack of proper oversight, staff training, and deep-seated systemic failures within public mental health facilities.

title: What will Trump’s latest tariffs mean for the world?
english: President Donald Trump has introduced new tariffs of up to 20 percent on 14 major trading partners, including the European Union and China. This move follows a Supreme Court decision that invalidated his previous trade measures. These actions have raised questions regarding global economic impacts and how these nations will retaliate in response.

title: Ethiopia’s Intellectual Crisis Begins With a Culture of Conformity
english: The article explores why Ethiopian society struggles with a lack of independent thought and intellectual growth. It argues that a cultural reliance on conformity and imitation prevents people from questioning authority or challenging established norms. To foster progress, society must shift toward valuing innovation and critical thinking over the traditional tendency to remain silent.

title: German boat dealer suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, BBC finds
english: European authorities suspect a German boat dealer, Marvin Reuter, of supplying small vessels and engines used by migrant smuggling groups to cross the English Channel. Investigations link his company to dozens of boat crossings and two fatal accidents that resulted in four deaths. Reuter is currently fighting extradition to France, where he faces potential charges for criminal conspiracy and manslaughter.

english: A German business owner named Marvin Reuter is being investigated for allegedly supplying boats and engines used by smuggling gangs to transport migrants across the English Channel. title: Desperate appeals from women on death row in Iran after protests
english: Several women, including twin sisters Taraneh and Romina Rahimi, have been sentenced to death in Iran following their participation in anti-government protests. Family members report that these women have faced severe physical abuse and coerced confessions while in custody. Human rights organizations warn of a significant and alarming increase in the use of capital punishment against political dissidents, though Iranian officials deny these allegations, claiming the sentences relate only to violent crimes.

title: New UK-EU treaty has 10-year termination clause
english: The UK and the EU are releasing two new treaties aimed at improving their post-Brexit trade relationship, specifically regarding food exports and carbon emissions. A key feature of the food agreement is a ten-year expiration clause, which requires the party that ends the deal to cover the costs of restoring border inspection facilities. While the government anticipates this will reduce red tape and boost agricultural exports, the agreement has already faced criticism from opposition leaders.

Mootummaan waliigalteen kun rakkoo biiroo hir'isee oomisha qonnaa akka dabalu abdachaa jiruus, mormitoonni garuu waliigalticha irratti mormii kaasanii jiru.

title: Musk's plan to send a million SpaceX data satellites into space approved
english: US regulators have authorized SpaceX to launch up to one million satellites into orbit to establish space-based data centers for artificial intelligence. The project, called Starmind, aims to leverage solar energy to process high-demand computing tasks that exceed current terrestrial capabilities. While the FCC supports the initiative as a boost to American innovation, critics including astronomers and competitors have expressed concerns regarding its feasibility and impact on night sky observations.

oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Amerikaa dhaabbata SpaceX-f qaala'iinsa teeknoolojii AI fiiziyela irra oolchuuf satelaayii miliyoona tokko gara hawaatti erguuf hayyama kennaniiru. Proojektiin 'Starmind' jedhamu kun anniisaa aduu fayyadamuun hojiiwwan kompiitaraa lafa irraa sadarkaa olaanaa irra jiran raawwachuuf kaayyeeffateera. Mootummaan Amerikaa tarkaanfii kana fooyya'iinsa diinagdee fi teeknoolojii akka ta'etti kan ilaalu yoo ta'u, ogeeyyonni urjii fi dhaabbileen biroon garuu hojii kana irratti shakkee fi miidhaa samii halkan irratti geessisu irratti komii qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Are Trump’s tariffs aimed at securing US-friendly trade deals?
english: President Donald Trump has announced plans to impose new import taxes ranging from 20 to 40 percent on 14 major trading partners, including China, India, and the European Union. The administration claims these measures are necessary to combat unfair trade practices and overproduction that damage American manufacturing. These tariffs appear to be a strategic negotiation tactic intended to force these countries into more favorable trade agreements for the United States.

oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp Chaayinaa, Hindii fi Gamtaa Awurooppaa dabalatee gurguddoo biyyoota 14 waliin daldallan irratti gibira meeshaalee alaa galchan kan dhibbeentaa 20 hanga 40 ga'u akka kaa'an beekameera. Mootummaan Tiraamp tarkaanfii kana kan fudhate, daldala sirrii hin taane fi oomisha hedduu kan oomisha Ameerikaa miidhan ittisuuf akka ta'e ibseera. title: Thanksgiving dinner costs rise, putting pressure on US households
english: The cost of a traditional Thanksgiving meal in the United States has increased by 11 percent compared to last year. Turkey prices have seen a significant jump of 26 percent, alongside double-digit price hikes for many common side dishes. Because of these rising expenses, many families are struggling to afford large gatherings and are opting for potluck-style meals instead.

title: Palestine coach says team represents suffering but also offers hope
english: Ihab Abu Jazar, the head coach of the Palestinian national football team, views his role as a meaningful way to provide hope to his people despite the ongoing war in Gaza. While managing the personal tragedy of his own family living in displacement, he leads the team as a symbol of resilience. Under his guidance, the squad has achieved significant victories, serving as a beacon of joy for Palestinians during these difficult times.

title: Kenya gov’t violated constitution with Ebola quarantine site, court says
english: Kenya's High Court has ruled that the government acted unconstitutionally by establishing a US-funded Ebola quarantine facility without public transparency or citizen participation. The court has ordered an immediate halt to all construction activities until officials disclose the details of their agreement with the United States. This decision follows months of violent local protests in Laikipia, where residents expressed significant safety concerns regarding the site.

title: Ukraine drone attack kills five in Russian-occupied Zaporizhia
english: A Ukrainian drone strike in the Russian-occupied Zaporizhia region resulted in five deaths and several injuries after hitting a parking area. In retaliation, Russian forces conducted a major ballistic missile assault on Kyiv that damaged a shopping center and other buildings. Meanwhile, both sides reported further military engagements involving strikes on aircraft bases and maritime cargo vessels.

title: Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway
english: A tragic fuel tanker accident on a busy Cairo highway resulted in at least 31 deaths and 21 injuries. Reports indicate the vehicle lost control and caught fire after colliding with a fallen power cable. Authorities have launched an investigation into the incident, which highlights ongoing concerns regarding road safety and infrastructure in the region.

title: Photos: Storms and an El Nino-charged king tide batter California’s coast
english: Parts of the United States West Coast are facing significant flooding and damage due to record-high tides and powerful storm surges. These dangerous conditions are being driven by a combination of a strong El Nino weather pattern, climate change, and the natural phenomenon known as king tides. Local officials are urging residents to remain vigilant and prepare for additional extreme tidal events expected throughout the coming winter months.

title: Ukraine attacks Russian military base, says five planes struck
english: Ukrainian forces recently conducted a long-range strike on the Savasleyka airbase in Russia's Nizhny Novgorod region. This attack is part of Kyiv's ongoing strategy to weaken Russia's military capabilities and infrastructure as the conflict continues.

title: UK moving military planes into hangars amid drone threat: reports

The government is also allocating an additional £470 million to enhance security infrastructure and surveillance at military installations across the country. These actions reflect ongoing official concerns regarding foreign threats, prompting the military to proactively update its defense strategies.
amharic: የብሪታንያ አየር ኃይል በአውሮፕላኖቹ ላይ ሊደርሱ የሚችሉ የድሮን ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል ሲል፣ አውሮፕላኖቹን ወደ ተጠበቁ ቦታዎች በማስገባት እና መረቦችን በመዘርጋት ላይ ይገኛል። መንግሥትም ለወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎች ደህንነት እና ለክትትል ስራዎች የሚውል ተጨማሪ 470 ሚሊዮን ፓውንድ መድቧል። እነዚህ ጥንቃቄዎች የሚወሰዱት ከውጭ ሀገራት የሚመጡ ስጋቶችን ለመቋቋም እና የሀገሪቱን የመከላከያ አቅም ለማዘመን ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni qilleensa biyya Ingilizii, xiyyaara isaanii miidhaa roopii (drone) irraa ittisuuf jecha bakka gaachana qabutti galchuufi akkasumas maroo ittisaa diriirsuuf hojjechaa jiru. Mootummaan biyyattii buufataalee waraanaa isaanii cimsuufi hordoffii fooyyessuuf maallaqa paawundii miiliyoona 470 dabalataa ramadeera. Tarkaanfileen kun kan fudhataman sodaa biyyoota alaa irraa dhuuu danda'u of irraa ittisuufi qophii waraana isaanii hammayyeessuufi.

title: Houthis say they attacked Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery in retaliation for deadly strikes
english: Houthi rebels have launched an attack on Saudi Arabia's primary oil refinery, Ras Tanura, resulting in fires at the facility. This strike was declared as a retaliatory action following Saudi military operations in Yemen that killed at least 26 civilians. The group stated the assault was intended to respond to recent attacks on civilian vehicles and infrastructure across several Yemeni regions.
amharic: የሁቲ አማፂያን በሳውዲ አረቢያ ትልቁ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ተቋም በሆነው ራስ ታኑራ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በየመን ሳውዲ አረቢያ ባደረሰችው እና ቢያንስ 26 ንፁሃን ዜጎች በተገደሉበት የአየር ድብደባ ምክንያት በቀል መውሰድ እንደሆነ ቡድኑ ገልጿል። የሁቲ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለጹት እርምጃው የተወሰደው በሲቪል መኪኖች እና መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ ለተፈጸሙ የሳውዲ ጥቃቶች ምላሽ ለመስጠት ነው።
oromo: Houthonni ergamtoota Yemen irraa ta'an, buufata qulqulleessa boba'aa guddaa Saudii Araabiyaa kan ta'e Ras Tanura irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame, duula waraana Saudii kan Yemen keessatti namoota nagaa 26 ol ajjeeseef haaloo ba'uuf akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Gareen kun akka jedhutti, haleellaan kun imalaannee fi qabeenya ummataa irratti haleellaa Saudiin raawwatteef deebii kan kennu dha.

title: Russia's own figures show it has lost almost 500,000 people in Ukraine war
english: Leaked official data analyzed by the BBC indicates that nearly 500,000 Russian soldiers have died since the invasion of Ukraine began in 2022. The records reveal that the war has become the leading cause of death for young Russian men, significantly impacting the country's demographic patterns. Experts suggest the true death toll could be even higher, as the conflict continues to claim thousands of lives for minor territorial gains.
amharic: ቢቢሲ ይፋ ባደረገው የተለቀቀ የመንግስት መረጃ መሠረት፣ ከ2022 ጀምሮ በዩክሬን ጦርነት ወደ 500,000 የሚጠጉ የሩሲያ ወታደሮች መሞታቸው ታውቋል። ይህ ጦርነት በሩሲያ ወጣት ወንዶች መካከል ዋነኛው የሞት መንስኤ በመሆን የሀገሪቱን የህዝብ ቁጥር ስብጥር ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ይገኛል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት፣ ጦርነቱ ለአነስተኛ መሬት ግዢ በሚያደርገው ፍልሚያ በርካታ ህይወቶችን እየቀጠፈ በመሆኑ፣ ትክክለኛው የሟቾች ቁጥር ከዚህም በላይ ሊሆን ይችላል።
oromo: Odeeffannoon mootummaa biyyattii irraa hatamee bahe kan BBC’n qoratame akka agarsiisutti, waraana Yukreenii kan bara 2022 jalqabeen loltoonni Raashiyaa gara 500,000 ta’an du’aniiru. Ragaan kun waraanni kun dargaggoota Raashiyaa gidduutti sababa guddaa du’aa ta’ee akka jiruufi caasaa namoota biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa cimaa geessisaa akka jiru ibsa. Ogeeyyoonni akka jedhanitti, waraanni kun lafa xiqqoo qabachuuf jedhee lubbuu namoota baay'ee waan galaafatuuf, baay'inni namoota du'anii ragaa kana caalaa ta'uu danda'a.

title: Four years after huge asteroid crash, a spacecraft has now returned to assess the damage
english: The European Space Agency's Hera spacecraft has arrived at the Dimorphos asteroid to study the lasting effects of a 2022 NASA crash test. This mission aims to analyze the crater and physical changes caused when the DART spacecraft intentionally collided with the rock to divert its orbit. By examining the impact site, scientists hope to refine planetary defense strategies for protecting Earth against future asteroid threats.
amharic: የአውሮፓ የጠፈር ምርምር ኤጀንሲ ሄራ የተሰኘው መንኮራኩር በ2022 ናሳ በአስትሮይድ ላይ ባደረገው የሙከራ ግጭት የተፈጠረውን ውጤት ለመመልከት ዲሞርፎስ የተባለውን አስትሮይድ ደርሷል። የዚህ ተልዕኮ ዓላማ የናሳ መንኮራኩር አስትሮይዱን ከምህዋሩ ለማስወጣት ባደረገው ግጭት በድንጋዩ ላይ የደረሰውን ጉዳት እና የቅርጽ ለውጥ ማጥናት ነው። ተመራማሪዎች ይህንን መረጃ በመጠቀም ወደፊት ምድርን ሊያሰጋ የሚችል አስትሮይድ ቢኖር እንዴት መከላከል እንደሚቻል የተሻለ እቅድ ለማውጣት ይጠቀሙበታል።
oromo: Ejensii Qorannoo Hawaa Awurooppaa kan ta'e 'Hera', asataroyidii Dimorphos jedhamu irra ga'uun, bara 2022 mootummaan Ameerikaa (NASA) qormaata ittisa lafaa geggeesse booda miidhaan qaqqabe maal akka fakkaatu qorachuu jalqabeera. Ergamaan kun, meeshaan hawaa DART asataroyidicha karaa isaa irraa maqsuuf itti bu'e sanaan booda, haalli dirra asataroyidichaa jijjiiramuu isaa hubachuuf gargaara. Qorannoon kun gara fuulduraatti asataroyidii lafaaf balaa ta'u danda'u tokko akkamitti fageessuu akka danda'amuuf gorsa saayinsii nuuf kenna.

title: The rising cost of putting food on the table in India
english: India is currently facing a sharp increase in food inflation, which reached nearly 9% in October due to unpredictable weather and supply chain issues. These rising costs are putting a significant financial burden on families, forcing many to cut back on leisure spending and purchase smaller quantities of basic goods. Economists note that because food remains a major part of the average Indian budget, this situation is creating serious economic and social challenges for the country.
amharic: ህንድ በአሁኑ ወቅት ባልተጠበቀ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ እና በአቅርቦት ችግሮች ምክንያት የምግብ ዋጋ ንረት ወደ 9 በመቶ የሚጠጋ ከፍተኛ ጭማሪ እያሳየች ነው። ይህ የዋጋ ጭማሪ በቤተሰቦች ላይ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ጫና በመፍጠሩ፣ ብዙዎች ከመዝናኛ ወጪዎቻቸውን በመቀነስ እና መሰረታዊ የፍጆታ ዕቃዎችን በመቀነስ እንዲኖሩ አስገድዷቸዋል። የምግብ ወጪ በአማካይ የህንድ ቤተሰቦች በጀት ውስጥ ትልቅ ድርሻ ስላለው፣ ይህ ሁኔታ በሀገሪቱ ላይ ከባድ ማህበራዊ እና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ተግዳሮቶችን እያስከተለ መሆኑን የኢኮኖሚ ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Indiyaan amma qilleensa tasgabbii hin qabnee fi rakkoo dhiyeessii midhaan nyaataa irraa kan ka'e, gatiin nyaataa gara dhibbeentaa 9tti ol guddatee jira. Nyaanni baajata maatiiwwan Indiyaa keessatti qooda guddaa waan qabuuf, rakkoon kun biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa diinagdee fi hawaasummaa cimaa uumaa jiraachuu ogeeyyoonni diinagdee ibsu.

title: See motorcycle passenger’s viral cricket catch
english: A video featuring a motorcycle passenger successfully catching a cricket ball has become a viral sensation online. The footage highlights the unusual and impressive reflexes of the passenger while riding through traffic. Social media users have widely shared the clip due to the surprising nature of the event.

oromo: Namichi mooraa mootsaayikilii irra taa'e tokko kubbaa kriketii qilleensa irraa qabate tokko vidiyoon isaa miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti baay'ee namatti toleera. title: Dozens of ports close as powerful waves damage Peru’s coastline
english: Peruvian officials have shut down many ports due to intense ocean swells that have caused damage to coastal structures. The country's navy attributes these dangerous sea conditions to the ongoing El Nino weather phenomenon. Authorities are keeping the ports closed temporarily to ensure safety while the rough seas persist.
amharic: የፔሩ ባለሥልጣናት በባህር ዳርቻው ላይ ጉዳት ያደረሱ ኃይለኛ ማዕበሎች በመከሰታቸው በርካታ ወደቦችን በጊዜያዊነት ዘግተዋል። የሀገሪቱ የባህር ኃይል እነዚህን አደገኛ የባህር ሁኔታዎች ከኤል ኒኖ የአየር ሁኔታ ጋር አያይዞታል። ማዕበሉ እስኪረጋጋ ድረስ የህዝብን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ ወደቦቹ ተዘግተው እንዲቆዩ ተወስኗል።
oromo: Hojjettoonni mootummaa Peru dhiibbaa gurguddaa qarqara galaanaatti miidhaa geessise hordofee, buufataaleen markabaa hedduun yeroof akka cufaman taasisaniiru. Raayyaan ittisa biyyattii haala qilleensa hamaa kana kan walqabsiise mul'ata 'El Nino' waliini. Buufataaleen kun hanga haalli qilleensichaa foyya'utti nageenya eeguuf cufamanii turu.

title: ‘We need to be seen’: Over a third of UK Muslim students face Islamophobia
english: A recent report by the Federation of Student Islamic Societies reveals that over one-third of Muslim students in the UK have encountered Islamophobia on university campuses. Female students are particularly vulnerable to these incidents, which range from verbal abuse and insults to physical harassment. Many victims feel unsupported by their institutions, leading to a growing call for universities to take more decisive action against discrimination.
amharic: የተማሪዎች እስላማዊ ማህበራት ፌዴሬሽን ይፋ ባደረገው አዲስ ሪፖርት መሰረት፣ በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የሚገኙ ከሶስት ሙስሊም ተማሪዎች በላይ የሚሆኑት በግቢ ውስጥ እስላሞፎቢያ ወይም የእስልምና ጥላቻ እንደገጠማቸው ተገልጿል። በተለይም ሴት ተማሪዎች ከቃል ስድብ እስከ አካላዊ ጥቃት ድረስ ባሉ አድልዎዎች የመጋለጥ እድላቸው ከፍተኛ መሆኑ ተመላክቷል። በርካታ ተማሪዎች የትምህርት ተቋማቱ ለችግሩ ተገቢውን ትኩረት እንዳልሰጡ በመግለጽ፣ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች መድልዎን ለመከላከል ጠንካራ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraa 'Federation of Student Islamic Societies' baase akka agarsiisutti, barattoonni Muslimaa UK keessa jiran tokko sadaffaa ol ta'an yunivarsitii keessatti jibba amantii (Islamophobia) irra ga'aa akka jiru ibseera. Keessattuu barattoonni dubartoonni arrabsamuufi miidhaa qaamaa irra ga'uuf saaxilamoo ta'uun isaanii beekameera. Barattoonni hedduun dhaabbileen barnootaa deeggarsa barbaachisu akka hin goone ibsuun, yunivarsitiin gidirsuu fi loogii kana dhaabsisuuf tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatan gaafachaa jiru.

title: Two Libyan soldiers die after Ukraine attack on Russian vessel
english: Two Libyan naval officers have passed away following a Ukrainian drone strike on a Russian warship docked near Benghazi. Libya's eastern-based military forces, which maintain close ties with Russia, have vowed to retaliate for the attack. Ukraine has confirmed its responsibility for the operation, while France expressed support, describing the action as a legitimate exercise of Ukraine's right to self-defense.

title: French ex-President Sarkozy and wife Carla Bruni to face trial
english: Former French President Nicolas Sarkozy and his wife, Carla Bruni, will stand trial next year regarding accusations of witness tampering. Authorities believe the couple attempted to discredit a key witness who had previously alleged that Sarkozy received illegal campaign funding from the late Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi. Both Sarkozy and Bruni maintain their innocence, even as the former president continues to face multiple ongoing legal challenges related to his political activities.

title: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering
english: A US jury has convicted Huawei of multiple charges, including stealing trade secrets, bank fraud, and violating international sanctions. While the company was found guilty on 10 out of 12 counts, jurors acquitted the tech giant of the more severe racketeering charges. Huawei officials expressed relief regarding the racketeering acquittal, maintaining that their business success is the result of genuine innovation rather than criminal activity.

title: Gunmen hold dozens hostage in Colombia supermarket
english: A group of armed individuals has taken about 20 people hostage inside a supermarket in Cartagena, Colombia. The situation began after an attempted robbery failed, forcing the suspects to hide in the store. The gunmen are currently requesting a payment of nearly $2 million in exchange for the safe release of the hostages.

title: Alaska ends deal to give voter records to US Justice Department
english: Alaska has officially canceled an agreement that allowed the U.S. Department of Justice to access its state voter records. Lieutenant Governor Nancy Dahlstrom stated the deal is no longer necessary now that the 2026 midterm elections have concluded. Throughout the agreement, federal officials never identified any ineligible voters or raised concerns about the state's registration data.

title: Iran war live: Houthis threaten Saudi ports over coalition’s Hodeidah order
english: Tensions in the region have escalated after a Saudi-led coalition ordered civilians to evacuate the Yemeni port of Hodeidah, leading the Houthi group to threaten retaliatory attacks on Saudi ports. Furthermore, the head of Iran's Revolutionary Guard warned that potential conflicts could spread globally and urged regional neighbors to reduce their security cooperation with the United States. This situation highlights the growing instability surrounding key maritime trade routes and international military alliances.

title: Rebel group retreats in DR Congo after heavy clashes with government forces
english: A rebel group led by Thomas Lubanga has pulled its fighters back from recently occupied territories in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. This retreat follows intense confrontations with government soldiers near the city of Bunia. The decision to withdraw was attributed to agreements reached during peace discussions mediated by the Ugandan government.

title: South Africa convicts Zimbabwean who tried to fight Ukraine for Russia
english: A South African court has sentenced a Zimbabwean man to a five-year suspended prison term after he admitted to attempting to travel to Russia to work as a mercenary. Tafadzwa Sithole was arrested at a Johannesburg airport while preparing to fly to Russia, having been recruited online for payment to join the war against Ukraine. He pleaded guilty to violating laws that ban mercenary activities and will now be deported back to his home country.

title: ‘Unfinished Beginnings’: Art installation for children affected by war
english: Artist Bachir Mohamad has created a powerful art installation in Doha titled 'Unfinished Beginnings,' which features 20,000 baby bottles. This exhibit aims to draw attention to the suffering of children impacted by conflict, hunger, and displacement. The project serves as a fundraiser for Qatar Charity and promotes the urgent message that war should not be the reality for any child.
amharic: አርቲስት ባሺር መሀመድ በዶሃ 'ያልተጠናቀቁ ጅማሬዎች' በሚል ርዕስ 20,000 የሕፃናት ወተት ጠርሙሶችን በመጠቀም አዲስ የጥበብ ሥራ አቅርቧል። ይህ ኤግዚቢሽን በጦርነት፣ በረሃብ እና ከመኖሪያቸው በተፈናቀሉ ህፃናት ላይ የሚደርሰውን ችግር ለማሳየት ያለመ ነው። ፕሮጀክቱ ለኳታር በጎ አድራጎት ድርጅት ገንዘብ በማሰባሰብ ላይ የሚገኝ ሲሆን፣ ማንኛውም ህፃን የጦርነት ሰለባ መሆን የለበትም የሚለውን መልእክት ያስተላልፋል።
oromo: Artist Bachir Mohamad Doha keessatti 'Jalqaba Hin Xumuramne' mata duree jedhuun, qodaa aannanii ijoollee 20,000 fayyadamuun hojii ogummaa tokko dhiyeesseera. Hojichi ijoollee waraana, beelaa fi buqqaatiin miidhaman irratti xiyyeeffata. Kaayyoon isaa gargaarsa 'Qatar Charity'f maallaqa walitti qabuu fi ijoolleen kamiyyuu waraana dhaaluu akka hin qabne dhaamsa dabarsuu dha.

title: Trump faces backlash after saying he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang
english: Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO shortly after he was forced to resign due to a scandal involving alleged links to Chinese intelligence. Donald Trump claimed credit for influencing the company's board to bring Huang back, sparking significant criticism from lawmakers. Despite the controversy, the announcement caused Nvidia's stock value to surge by nearly $1 trillion, helping to stabilize the broader market.
amharic: ኤንቪዲያ የኩባንያውን ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁአንግ ከቻይና የስለላ ድርጅት ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው ከተባለበት ቅሌት በኋላ ስራቸውን ለቀው እንደነበር ቢታወቅም አሁን ወደ ስልጣናቸው መልሰዋቸዋል። ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኩባንያው ቦርድ ሁአንግን እንዲመልሱ ለማሳመን ሚና እንደነበራቸው መናገራቸውን ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ትችት ገጥሟቸዋል። ምንም እንኳን ውዝግቡ ቢኖርም የሁአንግ ወደ ስልጣን መመለስ የኩባንያውን የገበያ ዋጋ በአንድ ትሪሊዮን ዶላር በማሳደግ የአክሲዮን ገበያውን ለማረጋጋት ችሏል።
oromo: Nvidia hojii geggeessaa isaanii Jensen Huang, walitti dhufeenya iccitii Chaayinaa wajjin qabaachuu isaatiin walqabatee dirqisiisanii hojiirraa er gaggeessanii booda, ammas gara hojiitti deebisaniiru. Donald Traamp hojiin kun akka deebi'uuf boordii dhaabbatichaa kan amansiise ofii isaanii ta'uu dubbachuun isaanii mormii cimaa siyaasaa isaan mudateera. Mormii kana hunda waliin, deebiin Huang gabaa aksiyoonaa dhaabbatichaa gara tiriliyoona tokkoon ol kan guddisse yoo ta'u, gabaa waliigalaas tasgabbeessuuf gargaareera.

title: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
english: Nato Secretary General Mark Rutte has pledged to protect alliance territory following reports that Russia may be planning to deploy a nuclear-armed satellite in space. German media outlets claim this potential weapon, allegedly named Sputnik-S, could be used to disable critical communication and observation satellites. While the Kremlin has dismissed these allegations as propaganda, Nato officials have confirmed they are reviewing their defense strategies to counter such potential threats.
amharic: የኔቶ ዋና ጸሐፊ ማርክ ሩቴ፣ ሩሲያ በህዋ ላይ የኒውክሌር መሣሪያ የታጠቀ ሳተላይት ልታሰማራ ትችላለች የሚል ዘገባ መውጣቱን ተከትሎ አሊያንሱ አካባቢውን እንደሚከላከል አስታውቀዋል። የጀርመን መገናኛ ብዙኃን እንደዘገቡት ከሆነ ስፑትኒክ-ኤስ የተሰኘው ይህ የሩሲያ ሳተላይት ወሳኝ የመገናኛ እና የክትትል ሳተላይቶችን የማውደም አቅም አለው። የሩሲያ መንግሥት ውንጀላውን የፕሮፓጋንዳ ዘመቻ በማለት ውድቅ ቢያደርግም፣ ኔቶ ይህንን ስጋት ለመመከት የመከላከያ ስልቶቹን እየገመገመ እንደሚገኝ ገልጿል።
oromo: Hogganaan Nato Maark Ruute, Raashiyaan satalaayitii meeshaa niwukilera hidhatee gara hawaatti erguuf karoorfachuu ishee ilaalchisee gabaasota baʼan hordofee, Nato naannawa isaa kamiyyuu akka ittisu waadaa galeera. Miidiyaaleen Jarman akka gabaasanitti, satalaayitiin 'Sputnik-S' jedhamu kun satalaayitoota qunnamtii fi hordoffii barbaachisoo taʼan miidhuu ykn balleessuu dandaʼa jedhamee sodaatama. Raashiyaan himannaa kana duula propagandaa jechuun kan haalte taʼus, Nato xiyyeeffannoo cimaa kennee ittisa isaa ammayyeessaa akka jiru beeksiseera.

title: India's 'cockroach' party leader says he was stopped from flying to UK
english: Saurav Das, a prominent leader of India's youth-led 'Cockroach' party, was prevented from boarding a flight to the UK at Delhi airport. Officials stated his passport had been flagged, though the specific reason for this action remains unconfirmed. Das claims the government blocked his trip to prevent him from delivering lectures at prestigious universities like Oxford, Cambridge, and Edinburgh.
amharic: የህንድ ወጣት የፖለቲካ ቡድን መሪ የሆኑት ሳውራቭ ዳስ ከኒው ዴሊ አየር ማረፊያ ወደ እንግሊዝ እንዳይበሩ ተከልክለዋል። የኢሚግሬሽን ባለስልጣናት ፓስፖርታቸው ላይ ችግር እንዳለ በመግለጽ ጉዟቸውን እንዳቆሙት ቢናገሩም፣ ትክክለኛው ምክንያት ግን አልታወቀም። ዳስ በበኩላቸው መንግስት በኦክስፎርድ እና በካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች ንግግር እንዳያደርጉ ሆን ብሎ እንደከለከላቸው በመግለጽ ይከሳሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii dargaggootaa Hindii kan 'Cockroach' jedhamu kan ta'an Saurav Das, buufata xiyyaaraa Deelii irraa gara UK akka hin deemne dhoorkamaniiru. Aangeyyoonni imigrationii paaspoortiin isaanii mallattoo of keessaa qaba jedhanii akka deeman hin heyyamneef, ta'us sababni isaa ifa hin taane. Das mootummaan barnoota dhaabbilee akka Oksford fi Kaambirijitti akka hin kennineef jecha akka isaan dhoorke himataniiru.

title: Pennsylvania reports ninth measles death in ongoing state outbreak
english: Pennsylvania has confirmed its ninth death from an ongoing measles outbreak that has affected 46 counties across the state. With over 1,600 cases recorded, local health officials are reporting higher mortality figures than the CDC due to differences in how federal and state agencies track these deaths. This outbreak is part of a larger national crisis, as the United States has officially lost its measles-elimination status following the highest number of infections since 1991.
amharic: ፔንስልቬንያ በግዛቷ እየተስፋፋ ባለው የኩፍኝ በሽታ ዘጠነኛውን የሞት አጋጣሚ አረጋግጣለች። በ46 ወረዳዎች ውስጥ ከ1,600 በላይ ጉዳዮች የተመዘገቡ ሲሆን፣ በፌደራል እና በግዛት ኤጀንሲዎች መካከል ባለው የመረጃ አያያዝ ልዩነት ምክንያት የሟቾች ቁጥር በተለያዩ ሪፖርቶች ላይ ተለያይቶ ይታያል። ይህ ወረርሽኝ በአሜሪካ አገራዊ ቀውስ ሆኗል፤ ከ1991 ወዲህ ከፍተኛው የኢንፌክሽን ቁጥር በመመዝገቡ አገሪቱ የኩፍኝ በሽታን ሙሉ በሙሉ የማጥፋት ዕውቅናዋን አጥታለች።
oromo: Pensilveeniyaatti dhibeen kofii hammaatee namoota sagal ajjeeseera; dhibee kunis godinaalee 46 keessatti babal'atee argameera. Namoonni 1,600 ol ta'an dhukkubichaan qabamanii jiru. Maddi oduu fi qaamni fayyaa biyyoolessaa (CDC) lakkoobsa du'aa irratti walii galuu dhabuu irraan kan ka'e, ragaan gandaa fi federaalaa wal hin simatu. Amerikaan bara 1991 booda lakkoobsa namoota dhibee kofii qabamanii baay'inaan erga galmeessitee booda, dhibee kanaan bilisa ta'uu ishee sadarkaa addunyaatti dhabdeetti.

title: Danish court backs ‘ghetto law’ used to evict ‘non-Western’ residents
english: Denmark's Supreme Court has upheld a controversial policy known as the 'ghetto law,' which permits the eviction of residents from neighborhoods with large minority populations. The government claims this initiative is intended to encourage better social integration. However, the ruling solidifies the legal authority to relocate individuals based on the demographic composition of their housing areas.
amharic: የዴንማርክ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት 'ጌቶ ህግ' በሚል የሚታወቀውንና አናሳ ማህበረሰቦች በሚበዙባቸው አካባቢዎች የሚኖሩ ሰዎችን ለማፈናቀል የሚያስችለውን አወዛጋቢ ህግ አጽድቋል። መንግስት ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ማህበረሰባዊ መስተጋብርን ለማሻሻል ነው ሲል ይከራከራል። የፍርድ ቤቱ ውሳኔ በመኖሪያ አካባቢዎች ስብጥር ላይ ተመስርቶ ሰዎችን ለማዛወር መንግስት ያለውን ህጋዊ ስልጣን ያጸናል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Denmark, 'seera ghetto' jedhamu kan namoota baay'ina sanyii adda addaa qaban iddoo jireenyaa isaanii irraa buqqisuuf gargaaruuf seera qabeessa ta'uu isaa murteesseera. Mootummaan akka jedhutti, tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame walitti makamuu hawaasaa fooyyessuufi. Haa ta'u malee, murtiin kun mootummaan gosa namoota iddoo tokko jiraatanirratti hunda'ee uummata buqqisuuf aangoo akka qabu mirkaneesseera.

title: Car bomb strikes governor’s office in Meta, Colombia
english: A car bomb detonated outside the governor's office in Villavicencio, located in the Meta Department of Colombia. The explosion resulted in significant structural damage to surrounding properties. Authorities are currently assessing the impact of the attack.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ ሜታ ግዛት ቪላቪሴንሲዮ ከተማ ውስጥ በሚገኘው የአስተዳዳሪው ቢሮ አቅራቢያ የመኪና ቦምብ ፈንድቷል። ፍንዳታው በአካባቢው በሚገኙ ሕንፃዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ባለሥልጣናት የደረሰውን ጉዳት መጠን በመገምገም ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Kolombiyaa, kutaa biyyaa Meetaa magaalaa Viilaviiseensiyootti, waajjira bulchaa biratti konkolaataan boombii hidhatame dhoheera. Dhoohaan kun manneen naannichatti argaman irratti miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Abbootiin taayitaa miidhaa dhoohaan kun geessise hordofaa jiru.

title: India’s best known bottled water under scrutiny
english: Indian authorities are conducting safety tests on all bottled water brands following reports that a batch of Bisleri, the nation’s leading water company, failed quality standards. The brand has publicly rejected these findings, asserting that its products remain completely safe for consumers. This move has prompted a widespread regulatory review to ensure water safety across the country.
amharic: የሕንድ ባለሥልጣናት የሀገሪቱ ታዋቂ የውኃ ምርት የሆነው ቢስሌሪ አንዱ ምርታቸው የደህንነት መስፈርቱን አላሟላም መባሉን ተከትሎ፣ በሁሉም የታሸጉ ውኃ አምራች ድርጅቶች ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው። ኩባንያው የቀረበውን ክስ ውድቅ በማድረግ ምርቶቹ ለተጠቃሚዎች ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ መሆኑን ገልጿል። ይህ ሁኔታ በሀገር አቀፍ ደረጃ የውኃ ጥራትን ለማረጋገጥ ሰፊ የቁጥጥር ሥራ እንዲጀመር አድርጓል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa Indiyaa, bishaan dhugaatii biyyattii keessatti baay'ee beekamaa ta'e 'Bisleri' jedhamu qulqullina akka hin qabne erga ibsamee booda, warshaalee bishaan dhugaatii hunda irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru. Kompaniin kun himannicha waakkatee, bishaan isaa fayyaa namootaaf miidhaa akka hin qabne mirkaneesseera. Tarkaanfin kun biyyattii keessatti qulqullina bishaan dhugaatii hunda irratti to'annoo cimaa akka godhamu taasiseera.

title: WHO chief visits Cuba as healthcare system deteriorates
english: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is visiting Cuba to evaluate the country's declining healthcare system. The nation is struggling with severe shortages of medical supplies and equipment due to an economic crisis exacerbated by United States energy sanctions. This three-day visit aims to address the challenges facing a system that was previously known for high-quality universal care.
amharic: የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት ዋና ዳይሬክተር ዶክተር ቴዎድሮስ አድሓኖም የኩባን የተዳከመ የጤና ስርዓት ለመገምገም በሃገሪቱ ጉብኝት እያደረጉ ነው። ኩባ በአሜሪካ የኢነርጂ ማዕቀቦች ምክንያት በተፈጠረ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ የተነሳ ከፍተኛ የህክምና ቁሳቁሶች እና የመድኃኒት እጥረት ገጥሟታል። የሶስት ቀናት ጉብኝታቸው የዚህን በአንድ ወቅት በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የተደነቀ የጤና ስርዓት ችግሮች ለመረዳት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Daayreektarri Olaanaa Dhaabbata Fayyaa Addunyaa Dr. Tedros Adhanom sirna fayyaa Kuubaa kan hir'ina cimaa keessa jiru gamaggamuuf biyyattii daawwachaa jiru. Kuubaan adabbii diinagdee kan Ameerikaan irratti feete irraa kan ka'e, hanqina meeshaalee yaalaa fi qorichaa cimaan miidhamaa jirti. Daawwannaan guyyaa sadii kun, sirna fayyaa durii beekamtii qabu ture kan amma rakkoo keessa jiruuf furmaata barbaaduuf kan gaggeeffamu dha.

title: Israel likely to lose Gaza genocide case if ICJ follows Myanmar ruling, Tel Aviv scholar says
english: An Israeli legal scholar warns that Israel faces a high risk of losing the genocide case brought by South Africa at the International Court of Justice. The expert notes that the court's recent ruling against Myanmar regarding the Rohingya provides a dangerous legal precedent for Israel. He argues that the current Israeli government is largely responsible for this situation due to its own actions and rhetoric during the ongoing conflict.
amharic: የእስራኤል የህግ ምሁር እንደተናገሩት፣ ደቡብ አፍሪካ በአለም አቀፉ የፍትህ ፍርድ ቤት በእስራኤል ላይ ያቀረበችው የዘር ማጥፋት ክስ ለእስራኤል አደገኛ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል። ፍርድ ቤቱ በቅርቡ በምያንማር ላይ የወሰነው ውሳኔ ለእስራኤል የዘር ማጥፋት ክስ ተመሳሳይ አስተሳሰብን ሊያንጸባርቅ እንደሚችል ባለሙያው ያብራራሉ። በመሆኑም አሁን ያለው የእስራኤል መንግስት በጦርነቱ ወቅት በወሰዳቸው እርምጃዎች እና በሰጣቸው መግለጫዎች ምክንያት ለዚህ ህጋዊ ችግር የራሱ ድርሻ እንዳለው ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Ogeessi seeraa Israa'el tokko akka ibsetti, himannaan duguuggaa sanyii Itoophiyaan irratti dhiyaate kuni Israa'eliif balaa guddaa akka qabu ibseera. Mana murtii idil-addunyaatti murtii dhiheenya kana biyya Miyaanmar irratti darbe, himannaa Israa'el irratti dhiyaateef bu'uura seeraa cimaa ta'u danda'a jedhaniiru. Ogeessi kun, mootummaan Israa'el ammaa tarkaanfii fudhateefi ibsa kennuun isaa rakkoo seeraa kana keessatti gahee akka qabu hima.

title: Watch: Three people killed in Israeli strike near police outpost in Gaza’s Khan Younis
english: At least three Palestinians were killed and five others were injured following an Israeli airstrike near a police station in Khan Younis, southern Gaza. This attack is part of a broader trend of violence, with officials reporting over 1,600 deaths and 5,000 injuries since the ceasefire was declared. The incident adds to the ongoing casualties resulting from frequent military actions in the region.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ጋዛ ካን ዩኒስ በሚገኝ የፖሊስ ጣቢያ አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሶስት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ አምስት ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱ ከተባለ በኋላ በተደጋጋሚ በሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ከ1,600 በላይ ፍልስጤማውያን ህይወታቸው አልፏል ከ5,000 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ይህ የቅርብ ጊዜ ጥቃት በአካባቢው እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጦርነት ቀውስ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Gaazaa kibbaatti, naannoo Kaani Yuunisitti buufata poolisii tokko biratti haleellaa xiyyaaraa Israa'el raawwatteen lubbuun namoota saddeetiifi miidhaan namoota shanirratti ga’eera. Waraana kana dhaabuuf walii galteen godhame ture jedhamus, haleellaa akkanaa ittifufiinsaan raawwatameen namoonni 1,600 ol du'anii, 5,000 ol ta'an immoo miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kunis rakkoo fi miidhaa naannichatti torbanoota darban keessa itti fufee jiruuf ragaa dha.

title: Israeli army storms Syrian village
english: Israeli military forces recently carried out operations inside Syrian territory, including searching homes in the village of Abidin. Additionally, troops established a security checkpoint in the Quneitra governorate to inspect local residents. These actions represent a notable increase in military activity within the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በሶሪያ ግዛት ውስጥ ዘመቻ በማካሄድ በአቢዲን መንደር የሚገኙ ቤቶችን ፈትሸዋል። በተጨማሪም በኩኔይትራ ግዛት አዲስ የፍተሻ ጣቢያ በማቋቋም ነዋሪዎችን መመርመር ጀምረዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣውን ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ የሚያሳዩ ናቸው።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el biyya Suriyaa keessatti tarkaanfii fudhataniin, gandoota Abidin keessatti manneen qorataniru. Kana malees, naannoo Quneitra keessatti daangaa to'annoo ijaaranii jiraattota qorachaa jiru. Tarkaanfiin kun naannichatti sochiin waraanaas ta'e jeeqamsi dabalaa akka jiru kan agarsiisuudha.
